conviction_note: Q3 revenue, EBITDA, 9M figures, net cash, backlog, order intake and a second guidance raise (EUR 760-790m revenue / EUR 220-230m EBITDA) all came out in the 21 Oct ad-hoc (+8.9% that day). So 12 Nov is a confirmation print, and the call is at 17:00, 30 minutes before the Xetra close, so most of any 2027 commentary lands after the window. Scaled: abs 3.5 x (2 x 0.47 - 1) = -0.21. The findings sum to -0.20, from small public items. The two numbers agree because there is nothing unpriced to separate them.

already_public.what: Ad-hoc (MAR Art. 17), 21 Oct 2026 07:00. Q3 revenue EUR 228.3m (+13.0%), Q3 EBITDA EUR 80.9m (+58%). 9M revenue EUR 565.6m, 9M EBITDA EUR 173.4m. Net cash EUR 262.7m at 30 Sep. 9M order intake EUR 451.4m. Backlog EUR 907.2m (EUR 1,245.5m incl. ARGE), down from EUR 1,101.5m a year earlier. 2026 guide raised a second time, to revenue EUR 760-790m (was 730-780) and EBITDA EUR 220-230m (was 180-200). The ad-hoc says the full quarterly report will be published 12 Nov.
5C-Tech Americas JV (Texas) for automated pipeline welding in the US. First project starts Q1 2027.
Financial calendar: 12 Nov 2026 'Quarterly-report Q3 2026 | Earnings call 5pm'.

new_in_release.expect: Confirms the pre-released Q3. I expect no change and no deviation (preliminary figures are rarely revised).
Detailed operating cash flow and working capital. Net cash of EUR 262.7m is already public, so a working-capital surprise is limited. Direction unknown.
Segment backlog and order-intake detail; market attention is on falling backlog and weak Q3 intake (~EUR 130m by the press's calculation). Unknown, slight negative risk.

FY2026 guide was raised only 3 weeks ago, so I expect it reiterated. The implied Q4 is conservative, but a change is unlikely in the report. A first verbal indication for 2027 could come on the 17:00 call, mostly after the window. Direction unknown.

session_check: bmo. The company's financial calendar lists '12 November 2026 | Quarterly-report Q3 2026 | Earnings call 5pm' (https://www.friedrich-vorwerk-group.de/en/investor-relations/financial-calendar/). The 21 Oct ad-hoc says the report 'will be available from 12 November 2026', and the last Q1 report (12 May 2026, corporate news via EQS) moved the stock -11.4% on the release day itself. So the release lands before or during the 12 Nov session and the close(11 Nov)->close(12 Nov) window holds it. I have no exact timestamp for the report itself. The 17:00 CET call overlaps only the last 30 minutes of Xetra trading, so call commentary is mostly priced on 13 Nov.

Not crowded, neither building nor covering. Source: https://www.bundesanzeiger.de/pub/en/nlp?0--top~csv~form~panel-form-csv~resource~link (baseline, as_of 2026-11-10).

findings.finding: The release mainly details a shrinking order book: backlog EUR 907.2m vs EUR 1,101.5m a year earlier (incl. ARGE EUR 1,245.5m vs 1,539.6m), total project volume acquired 9M EUR 618.1m vs 815.3m, implied Q3 intake ~EUR 130m, more than a third below the prior year. The press preview names order intake and backlog as the focus of the 12 Nov report.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Past pre-released report days moved little: 13 Nov 2025 +1.4% (then -4.8% the next day), 13 Aug 2026 -1.3%, 31 Mar 2026 -0.3% (then -4.3%). Order worries did not stop the +8.9% reaction to the 21 Oct ad-hoc.
findings.original_quote: Der Auftragseingang liegt mit knapp 130 Millionen Euro mehr als ein Drittel unter dem Vorjahreswert, auch der Auftragsbestand ist zurückgegangen. ... Dann dürften neben der Bestätigung der vorläufigen Ergebnisse insbesondere Auftragsbestand und Auftragseingang im Mittelpunkt stehen. (Translation: order intake of just under EUR 130m is more than a third below the prior year and the backlog has fallen too ... besides confirming the preliminary results, the report should focus on backlog and order intake.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the backlog and 9M intake figures are in the 21 Oct ad-hoc. What remains is the segment split and any post-quarter award commentary, which nobody has seen. If the market were not worried, the stock would trade above the 200-day line and the press would not be calling the order book a 'wesentliches Risiko' (key risk). Sized near zero because the numbers are out.
findings.independence: Primary numbers from the ad-hoc https://www.eqs-news.com/news/ad-hoc/friedrich-vorwerk-increases-ebitda-by-58-to-e80-9-million-in-the-third-quarter-and-raises-its-2026-forecast-to-e760-790-million-revenue-and-e220-230-million-ebitda/83d91d55-8cd0-46ba-b438-32df6f474c2a_en (same underlying fact, so this is one finding).

findings.finding: Into the print the stock (sealed 74.60, +11.7% over 20 sessions, +4.3% over 5) sits above two of the three named sell-side targets: Jefferies Hold EUR 65 (13 Jul 2026) and mwb research Hold, raised from EUR 70 to EUR 73 after the Q3 ad-hoc. Berenberg is Buy with a EUR 110-120 target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 21 Oct ad-hoc spike to 72.60 the stock gave back 5.7% the next day (68.45), a sell-the-strength pattern near the hold targets. 11 Nov rose 3.2% intraday on the lowest volume of the quarter.
findings.original_quote: Das Analysehaus Jefferies hat Friedrich Vorwerk beim unveränderten Kursziel von 65 Euro von "Underperform" auf "Hold" hochgestuft. (Translation: Jefferies upgraded Friedrich Vorwerk from Underperform to Hold, target unchanged at EUR 65.) Also goldesel, 21 Oct 2026: 'Ein anderer erhöhte sein Kursziel von 70 auf 73 Euro, blieb aber bei Hold.' (Translation: another raised his target from 70 to 73 euros but stayed at Hold.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the targets are public. It overlaps the run-up free control, and the Jefferies target is four months old and may have been revised. Sized small for those reasons.

findings.finding: Two days before the report the company announced the 5C-Tech Americas JV (Texas) for automated large-diameter pipeline welding, with a first project scheduled for Q1 2027. The quarterly report and call may expand on it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Contract and strategic news days: +1.5% on 10 Nov 2026 (JV day), and a modest reaction to the 15 Jul 2026 H2Coastlink award.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since 10 Nov 07:16 and the stock rose on 10-11 Nov, so largely priced. No financial size has been disclosed, so the report or call could quantify it. Revenue contribution starts in 2027 and is small relative to a EUR 760-790m group.

outside_window.finding: The raised FY2026 guide implies a conservative Q4: Q4 revenue EUR 194-224m vs EUR 199.3m in Q4 2025, and Q4 EBITDA EUR 46.6-56.6m, below Q4 2025's EUR 57.5m even at the top end. In 2025 the company guided EUR 650-680m / 20-22% margin after Q3 and delivered EUR 704m / 23.2% (ad-hoc 26 Jan 2026), so a further beat is plausible. It resolves with the preliminary FY figures (late Jan 2027), not on 12 Nov; at most the 17:00 call may hint at it.

Any verbal 2027 outlook (last year's Q3 call gave 'double-digit growth in 2026 and 2027', per Quartr's summary) would come on the 17:00 CET call. That is 30 minutes before the Xetra close, so most of the reaction is priced on 13 Nov, outside the bmo window. Direction unknown given the falling backlog.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is mildly positive (+0.44: 1.7% short, no building, offset by the run-up). My small negative rests on public items and a run-up toward hold targets, so it agrees with the run-up free control and slightly opposes the squeeze component. Neither is strong, and p_up stays near 50.
language_note: German press (goldesel, 21 Oct) carried the derived Q3 order intake (~EUR 130m, more than a third below the prior year) and the framing that the 12 Nov report would centre on backlog and order intake. The English ad-hoc gives only 9M cumulative figures.

The German dpa-AFX broker flash (via live.deutsche-boerse.com) and the German retail press carried the sell-side targets (Jefferies EUR 65 Hold, mwb EUR 70->73 Hold, Berenberg Buy EUR 110-120). No English source surfaced them.
The primary disclosures (ad-hoc, JV news, calendar) are bilingual from the issuer and the English versions carried everything material.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': halved the backlog/order-intake finding from -0.3 to -0.15, since the figures are in the 21 Oct ad-hoc.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not the thing to agree with': the target/run-up finding overlaps the run-up free control, so cut from -0.2 to -0.1.
JV finding cut from +0.1 to +0.05 because it was public 10 Nov and the stock already reacted.

'The move is in the guide' plus the pre-released base of ~3%: abs_move_pct kept at 3.5 (pre-released period, guide unchanged, but a 60% realised-vol name). p_up kept at 47, inside the 45-55 band for a pre-released period.
'A German ad-hoc filed before the print may have pre-released the number': confirmed, the 21 Oct Prognoseerhöhung ad-hoc is exactly this case.
